vb4:1.2: dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ dukkhasamudayo ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodho ariyasaccaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ.
vb4:2.2: Jāti pi dukkhā jarā pi dukkhā maraṇam pi dukkhaṃ sokaparideyadukkhadomanassupāyāsā pi dukkhā appiyehi sampayogo dukkho piyehi vippayogo dukkho yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ; saṅkhittena pañcupādānakkhandhā pi dukkhā.
vb4:3.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho:
vb4:4.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jarā jīraṇatā khaṇḍiccaṃ pāliccaṃ valittacatā āyuno saṃhāni indriyānaṃ paripāko:
vb4:5.2: Yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye cuti cavanatā bhedo antaradhānaṃ maccu maraṇaṃ kālakiriyā khandhānaṃ bhedo kaḷevarassa nikkhepo jīvitindriyassa upacchedo:
vb4:6.2: Ñativyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa bhogavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa rogavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa sīlavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa diṭṭhivyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa aññataraññatarena vyasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa soko socanā socitattaṃ antosoko antoparisoko cetaso parijjhāyanā domanassaṃ sokasallaṃ:
vb4:7.2: Ñātivyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa bhogavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa rogavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa sīlavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa diṭṭhivyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa aññataraññatarena vyasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa ādevo paridevo ādevanā paridevanā ādevitattaṃ paridevitattaṃ vācā palāpo vippalāpo lālapo lālapanā lālapitattaṃ;
vb4:8.2: Yaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ kāyasamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā:
vb4:9.2: Yaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā:
vb4:10.2: Ñātivyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa bhogavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa rogavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa sīlavyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa diṭṭhivyasanena vā phuṭṭhassa aññataraññatarena vyasanena samannāgatassa aññataraññatarena dukkhadhammena phuṭṭhassa āyāso upāyāso āyāsitattaṃ upāyāsitattaṃ:
vb4:11.2: Idha yassa te honti aniṭṭhā akantā amanāpā rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā ye vā pan' assa te honti anatthakāmā ahitakāmā aphāsukāma ayogakkhemakāmā,
vb4:11.3: yā tehi saṅgati samāgamo samodhānaṃ missībhāvo:
vb4:12.2: Idha yassa te honti iṭṭhā kantā manāpā rūpā saddā gandhā rasā phoṭṭhabbā, ye vā pan' assa te honti atthakāmā hitakāmā phāsukāmā yogakkhemakāmā, mātā vā pitā vā bhātā vā bhaginī vā mittā vā amaccā vā ñātisālohitā vā,
vb4:12.3: yā tehi asaṅgati asamāgamo asamodhānaṃ amissībhāvo;
vb4:13.1: Tattha katamaṃ yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ?
vb4:13.3: aho vata mayaṃ na jātidhammā assāma,
vb4:13.4: na ca vata no jāti āgaccheyyāti,
vb4:13.5: na kho pan' etaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ:
vb4:13.6: idam pi yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkhaṃ.
vb4:14.5: aho vata mayaṃ na sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā assāma,
vb4:14.6: na ca vata no sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā āgaccheyyun ti,
vb4:14.7: na kho pan' etaṃ icchāya pattabbaṃ:
vb4:14.8: idam pi yam p' icchaṃ na labhati tam pi dukkaṃ.

vb4:43.2: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ:
vb4:43.3: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammā-ājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
vb4:44.2: Dukkhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ:
vb4:46.2: Musāvādā veramaṇī pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī samphappalāpā veramaṇī:
vb4:47.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī adinnādānā veramaṇī kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī:
vb4:48.2: Idha ariyasāvako micchā-ājīvaṃ pahāya sammā-ajīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti:
vb4:49.2: Idha bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
vb4:49.3: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya . . . pe . . .
vb4:49.5: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāri pūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati:
vb4:50.2: Idha bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
vb4:50.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ:
vb4:51.2: Idha bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pīti-sukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
vb4:51.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
vb4:51.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedenti yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti, tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
vb4:51.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb' eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
vb4:56.2: Avasesā ca kilesā avasesā ca akusalā dhammā tīṇi ca kusalamūlāni sāsavāni, avasesā ca sāsavā kusalā dhammā sāsavā kusalākusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā ye ca dhammā kiriyā neva kusalā nākusalā na ca kammavipākā sabbañ ca rūpaṃ:
vb4:58.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ; tasmiṃ samaye atthaṅgiko maggo hoti; sammādiṭṭhi . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi.
vb4:59.2: Yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:60.2: Yo takko vitakko . . . pe . . . sammāsaṅkappo maggaṃgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:61.2: Yā catūhi vacīduccaritehi ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī akiriyā akaraṇaṃ anajjhāpatti velā-anatikkamo setughāto sammāvācā maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:62.2: Yā tīhi kāyaduccaritehi ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī akiriyā akaraṇaṃ anajjhāpatti velā-anatikkamo setughāto sammākammanto maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:63.2: Yā micchā ājīvā ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī akiriyā akaraṇaṃ anajjhāpatti velā-anatikkamo setughāto sammā-ājīvo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:64.2: Yo cetasiko viriyārambho . . . pe . . . sammāvāyāmo viriyasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:65.2: Yā sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:66.2: Yā cittassa ṭhiti . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:68.2: Avasesā ca akusalā dhammā tīṇi ca kusalamūlāni avasesā ca sāsavā kusalā dhammā sāsavā kusalākusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā ye ca dhammā kiriyā neva kusalā nākusalā na ca kammavipākā sabbañ ca rūpaṃ:
vb4:69.2: Taṇhāya ca avasesānañ ca kilesānaṃ pahānaṃ:
vb4:70.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb4:71.2: Taṇhā ca avasesā ca kilesā avasesā ca akusalā dhammā:
vb4:72.2: Tīṇi ca kusalamūlāni sāsavāni avasesā ca sāsavā kusalā dhammā sāsavā kusalākusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā ye ca dhammā kiriyā neva kusalā nākusalā na ca kammavipākā sabbañ ca rūpaṃ:
vb4:73.2: Taṇhāya ca avasesānañ ca kilesānaṃ avasesānañ ca akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ:
vb4:74.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb4:75.2: Taṇhā ca avasesā ca kilesā avasesā ca akusalā dhammā tīṇi ca kusalamūlāni sāsavāni:
vb4:76.2: Avasesā ca sāsavā dhammā sāsavā kusalākusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā ye ca dhammā kiriyā neva kusalā nākusalā na ca kammavipākā sabbañ ca rūpaṃ:
vb4:77.2: Taṇhāya ca avasesānañ ca kilesānaṃ avasesānañ ca akusālānaṃ dhammānaṃ tiṇṇannañ ca kusalamūlānaṃ sāsavānaṃ pahānaṃ:
vb4:78.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb4:79.2: Taṇhā ca avasesā ca kilesā avasesā ca akusalā tīṇi ca kusalamūlāni sāsavāni avasesā ca sāsavā kusalā dhammā:
vb4:80.2: Sāsavā kusalākusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā ye ca dhammā kiriyā neva kusalā nākusalā na ca kammavipākā sabbañ ca rūpaṃ:
vb4:81.2: Taṇhāya ca avasesānañca kilesānaṃ avasesānañ ca akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ tiṇṇannañ ca kusalamūlānaṃ sāsavānaṃ avasesānañ ca sāsavānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānaṃ:
vb4:82.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb4:85.2: Avasesā ca kilesā avasesā ca akusalā dhammā tīṇi ca kusalamūlāni sāsavāni avasesā ca sāsavā kusalā dhammā sāsavā kusalākusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ vipākā ye ca dhammā kiriyā neva kusalā nākusalā na ca kammavipākā sabbañ ca rūpaṃ:
vb4:87.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye pañcaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb4:88.2: Yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṃgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:89.2: Yo takko vitakko saṅkappo . . . pe . . . maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:90.2: Yo cetasiko viriyārambho . . . pe . . . sammāvāyāmo viriyasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:91.2: Yā sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:92.2: Yā cittassa ṭhiti . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb4:92.5: Avasesā dhammā dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya sampayuttā . . . pe . . . vii.

vb4:108.1: Catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ kati kusalā, kati akusalā, kati avyākatā . . . pe . . . kati saraṇā, kati araṇā?
vb4:109.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kusalaṃ siyā akusalaṃ siyā avyākataṃ.
vb4:110.1: Dve saccā siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā;
vb4:110.3: sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttan ti pi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttan ti pi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttan ti pi;
vb4:110.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ siyā dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttan ti pi dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttan ti pi adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttan ti pi.
vb4:111.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā vipākaṃ siyā vipākadhammadhammaṃ siyā neva-vipā ka-na -vipākadhammadhammaṃ.
vb4:114.3: maggasaccaṃ siyā savitakka-savicāraṃ siyā avitakka-vicāramattaṃ siyā avitakka-avicāraṃ;
vb4:114.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā savitakka-savicāraṃ siyā avitakka-vicāramattaṃ siyā avitakka-avicāraṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ savitakkasavicāran ti pi avitakka-vicāramattan ti pi avitakkaavicāran ti pi.
vb4:115.1: Dve saccā siyā pītisahagatā siyā sukhasahagatā siyā upekhāsahagatā;
vb4:115.3: pītisahagatan ti pi sukhasahagatan ti pi upekhāsahagatan ti pi;
vb4:115.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā pītisahagataṃ siyā sukhasahagataṃ siyā upekhāsahagataṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ pītisahagatan ti pi sukhasahagatan ti pi upekhāsahagatan ti pi.
vb4:116.1: Dve saccā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbā;
vb4:116.2: samudayasaccaṃ siyā dassanena pahātabbaṃ siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ;
vb4:116.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā dassanena pahātabbaṃ siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ siyā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ.
vb4:117.1: Dve saccā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā;
vb4:117.2: samudayasaccaṃ siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ;
vb4:117.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ siyā neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ.
vb4:118.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā ācayagāmi siyā neva ācayagāmi na apacayagāmi.
vb4:121.3: samudayasaccaṃ siyā parittārammaṇaṃ siyā mahaggatārammaṇaṃ na appamāṇārammaṇaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ parittārammaṇan ti pi mahaggatārammaṇan ti pi;
vb4:121.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā parittārammaṇaṃ siyā mahaggatārammaṇaṃ siyā appamāṇārammaṇaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ parittārammaṇan ti pi mahaggatārammaṇan ti pi appamāṇārammaṇan ti pi.
vb4:123.3: dve saccā siyā micchattaniyatā siyā aniyatā.
vb4:124.3: maggārammaṇan ti pi maggahetukan ti pi maggādhipatīti pi;
vb4:124.4: maggasaccaṃ na maggārammaṇaṃ siyā maggahetukaṃ siyā maggādhipati siyā na vattabbaṃ maggahetukan ti pi maggādhipatīti pi;
vb4:124.5: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā maggārammaṇaṃ na maggahetukaṃ, siyā maggādhipati siyā na vattabbaṃ maggārammaṇan ti pi maggādhipatīti pi.
vb4:125.1: Dve saccā siyā uppannā siyā anuppannā na vattabbā
vb4:125.4: uppannan ti pi anuppannan ti pi uppādīti pi;
vb4:125.5: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā uppannaṃ siyā anuppannaṃ siyā uppādi.
vb4:126.1: Tīṇi saccā siyā atītā siyā anāgatā siyā paccuppannā;
vb4:126.3: atītan ti pi anāgatan ti pi paccuppannan ti pi.
vb4:127.3: atītārammaṇan ti pi anāgatārammaṇan ti pi paccuppannārammaṇan ti pi;
vb4:127.4: dve saccā siyā atītārammaṇā siyā anāgatārammaṇā siyā paccuppannārammaṇā siyā na vattabbaṃ atītārammaṇā ti pi anāgatārammaṇā ti pi paccuppannārammaṇā ti pi.
vb4:128.2: tīṇi saccā siyā ajjhattā siyā bahiddhā siyā ajjhattabahiddhā.
vb4:129.3: samudayasaccaṃ siyā ajjhattārammaṇaṃ siyā bahiddhārammaṇaṃ siyā ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇaṃ;
vb4:129.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā ajjhattārammaṇaṃ siyā bahiddhārammaṇaṃ siyā ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ ajjhattārammaṇan ti pi bahiddhārammaṇan ti pi ajjhattabahiddhārammaṇan ti pi.
vb4:130.2: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā sanidassana-sappaṭighaṃ siyā anidassana-sappaṭighaṃ siyā anidassana-appaṭighaṃ.
vb4:131.3: dve saccā siyā hetū siyā na hetū.
vb4:131.12: hetu ceva sahetukañ cāti pi sahetukañ ceva na ca hetūti pi;
vb4:131.13: maggasaccaṃ siyā hetu ceva sahetukañ ca siyā sahetukañ ceva na ca hetu;
vb4:131.14: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā hetu ceva sahetukañ ca siyā sahetukañ ceva na ca hetu siyā na vattabbaṃ hetu ceva sahetukañ cāti pi sahetukañ ceva na ca hetūti pi;
vb4:131.17: hetu ceva hetusampayuttañ cāti pi hetusampayuttañ ceva na ca hetūti pi;
vb4:131.18: maggasaccaṃ siyā hetu ceva hetusampayuttañ ca siyā hetusampayuttañ ceva na ca hetu;
vb4:131.19: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā hetu ceva hetusampayuttañ ca siyā hetusampayuttañ ceva na ca hetu siyā na vattabbaṃ hetu ceva hetusampayuttañ cāti pi hetusampayuttañ ceva na ca hetūti pi.
vb4:131.22: na hetu sahetukan ti pi na hetu ahetukan ti pi;
vb4:131.23: maggasaccaṃ siyā na hetu sahetukaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ na hetu sahetukan ti;
vb4:131.24: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā na hetu sahetukaṃ siyā na hetu ahetukaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ na hetu sahetukan ti pi na hetu ahetukan ti pi.
vb4:133.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā āsavo siyā no āsavo.
vb4:133.11: āsavā ceva sāsavā cāti pi sāsavā ceva no ca āsavā ti pi;
vb4:133.12: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā āsavo ceva sāsavañ ca siyā sāsavañ ceva no ca āsavo.
vb4:133.15: āsavā ceva āsavasampayuttā cāti pi āsavasampayuttā ceva no ca āsavā ti pi;
vb4:133.16: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā āsavo ceva āsavasampayuttañ ca siyā āsavasampayuttañ ceva no ca āsavo siyā na vattabbaṃ āsavo ceva āsavasampayuttañ cāti pi āsavasampayuttañ ceva no ca āsavo ti pi.
vb4:133.19: āsavavippayutta-sāsavan ti pi āsavavippayutta-anāsavan ti pi;
vb4:133.20: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā āsavavippayutta-sāsavaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ āsavavippayuttasāsavan ti pi āsavavippayutta-anāsavan ti pi.
vb4:134.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā saṃyojanaṃ siyā no saṃyojanaṃ.
vb4:134.11: saṃyojanā ceva saṃyojaniyā cāti pi saṃyojaniyā ceva no ca saṃyojanā ti pi;
vb4:134.12: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā saṃyojanañ ceva saṃyojaniyañ ca siyā saṃyojaniyañ ceva no ca saṃyojanaṃ.
vb4:134.15: saṃyojanā ceva saṃyojanasampayuttā cāti pi saṃyojanasampayuttā ceva no ca saṃyojanā ti pi;
vb4:134.16: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā saṃyojanañ ceva saṃyojanasampayuttañ ca siyā saṃyojanasampayuttañ ceva no ca saṃyojanaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ saṃyojanañ ceva saṃyojanasampayuttañ cāti pi saṃyojanasampayuttañ ceva no ca saṃyojanan ti pi.
vb4:134.19: saṃyojanavippayutta-saṃyojaniyan ti pi. Saṃyojanavippayutta-asaṃyojaniyan ti pi;
vb4:134.20: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā saṃyojanavippayutta-saṃyojaniyaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ saṃyojanavippayutta-saṃyojaniyan ti pi saṃyojanavippayutta-asaṃyojaniyan ti pi.
vb4:135.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā gantho siyā no gantho.
vb4:135.7: dve saccā siyā ganthasampayuttā siyā ganthavippayuttā.
vb4:135.10: ganthā ceva ganthaniyā cāti pi ganthaniyā ceva no ca ganthā ti pi;
vb4:135.11: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā gantho ceva ganthaniyañ ca siyā ganthaniyañ ceva no ca gantho.
vb4:135.12: Samudayasaccaṃ gantho ceva ganthasampayuttañ ca siyā na vattabbaṃ gantho ceva ganthasampayuttañ cāti;
vb4:135.14: gantho ceva ganthasampayuttā cāti pi ganthasampayuttā ceva no ca ganthā ti pi;
vb4:135.15: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā gantho ceva ganthasampayuttañ ca siyā ganthasampayuttañ ceva no ca gantho siyā na vattabbaṃ gantho ceva ganthasampayuttañ cāti pi ganthasampayuttañ ceva no ca gantho ti pi.
vb4:135.17: dve saccā siyā ganthavippayutta-ganthaniyā siyā na vattabbā ganthavippayutta-ganthaniyā ti pi siyā ganthavippayutta-aganthaniyā ti pi.
vb4:136.5: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā nīvaraṇaṃ siyā no nīvaraṇaṃ.
vb4:136.6: Dve saccā nīvaraṇiyā; dve saccā anīvaraṇiyā.
vb4:136.12: nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇiyā cāti pi nīvaraṇiyā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā ti pi;
vb4:136.13: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇiyañ ca siyā nīvaraṇiyañ ceva no ca nīvaraṇaṃ.
vb4:136.16: nīvaraṇā ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttā cāti pi nīvaraṇasampayuttā ceva no ca nīvaraṇā ti pi;
vb4:136.17: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ca siyā nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ceva no ca nīvaraṇaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ nīvaraṇañ ceva nīvaraṇasampayuttañ cāti pi nīvaraṇasampayuttañ ceva no ca nīvaraṇan ti pi.
vb4:136.20: nīvaraṇavippayutta-nīvaraṇiyan ti pi nīvaraṇavippayutta-anīvaraṇiyan ti pi;
vb4:136.21: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā nīvaraṇavippayutta-nīvaraṇiyaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ nīvaraṇavippayutta-nīvaraṇiyan ti pi nīvaraṇavippayutta-anīvaraṇiyan ti pi.
vb4:137.2: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā parāmāso siyā no parāmāso.
vb4:137.7: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā parāmāsasampayuttaṃ siyā parāmāsavippayuttaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ parāmāsasampayuttan ti pi parāmāsavippayuttan ti pi.
vb4:137.9: parāmāso ceva parāmaṭṭhañ cāti, parāmaṭṭhañ ceva no ca parāmāso;
vb4:137.11: parāmāsā ceva parāmaṭṭhā cāti pi parāmaṭṭhā ceva no ca parāmāsā ti pi;
vb4:137.12: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā parāmāso ceva parāmaṭṭhañ ca siyā parāmaṭṭhañ ceva no ca parāmāso.
vb4:137.14: dve saccā siyā parāmāsavippayutta-parāmaṭṭhā siyā na vattabbā parāmāsavippayuttaparāmaṭṭhā ti pi parāmāsavippayutta-aparāmaṭṭhā ti pi.
vb4:138.5: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittaṃ siyā no cittaṃ.
vb4:138.11: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittasampayuttaṃ siyā cittavippayuttaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ cittena sampayuttan ti pi cittena vippayuttan ti pi.
vb4:138.14: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ siyā cittavisaṃsaṭṭhaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ cittena saṃsaṭṭhan ti pi cittena visaṃsaṭṭhan ti pi.
vb4:138.17: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ siyā no cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ.
vb4:138.20: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittasahabhu siyā no cittasahabhū .
vb4:138.23: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittānuparivatti siyā no cittānuparivatti.
vb4:138.26: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ siyā no cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhānaṃ.
vb4:138.29: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhāna- sahabhū siyā no cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāna- sahabhū .
vb4:138.32: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā cittasaṃsaṭṭha- samuṭṭhānānuparivatti siyā no cittasaṃsaṭṭha-samuṭṭhānānuparivatti.
vb4:139.4: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā upādā siyā no upādā.
vb4:140.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā upādānaṃ siyā no upādānaṃ.
vb4:140.7: dve saccā siyā upādānasampayuttā siyā upādānavippayuttā.
vb4:140.10: upādānā ceva upādāniyā cāti pi upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā ti pi;
vb4:140.11: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā upādānañ ceva upādāniyañ ca siyā upādāniyañ ceva no ca upādānaṃ.
vb4:140.12: Samudayasaccaṃ siyā upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca siyā na vattabbaṃ upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ cāti;
vb4:140.14: upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā cāti pi upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā ti pi;
vb4:140.15: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ ca siyā upādānasampayuttañ ceva no ca upādānaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ upādānañ ceva upādānasampayuttañ cāti pi upādānasampayuttañ ceva no ca upādānan ti pi.
vb4:140.17: dve saccā siyā upādānavippayutta-upādāniyā siyā na vattabbā upādānavippayuttaupādāniyā ti pi upādānavippayutta-anupādāniyā ti pi.
vb4:141.3: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kileso siyā no kileso.
vb4:141.14: kilesā ceva saṅkilesikā cāti pi saṅkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā ti pi;
vb4:141.15: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kileso ceva saṅkilesikañ ca siyā saṅkilesikañ ceva no ca kileso.
vb4:141.18: kilesā ceva saṅkiliṭṭhā cāti pi saṅkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā ti pi;
vb4:141.19: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kileso ceva saṅkiliṭṭhañ ca siyā saṅkiliṭṭhañ ceva no ca kileso, siyā na vattabbaṃ kileso ceva saṅkiliṭṭhañ cāti pi saṅkiliṭṭhañ ceva no ca kileso ti pi.

vb4:141.23: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ ca siyā kilesasampayuttañ ceva no ca kileso siyā na vattabaṃ kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ cāti pi kilesasampayuttañ ceva no ca kileso ti pi.
vb4:141.26: kilesavippayutta-saṅkilesikan ti pi kilesavippayutta-asaṅkilesikan ti pi;
vb4:141.27: dukkhasaccaṃ siyā kilesavippayutta-saṅkilesikaṃ siyā na vattabbaṃ kilesavippayutta-saṅkilesikan ti pi kilesavippayutta-asaṅkilesikan ti pi.
